goal: Close relevant Brainstorm decision dependencies and conserve the complete approved outcome through Planner handoff, including clear zero-question requests and staged implementation.

acceptance.assertion: Implement the S1 design of docs/specs/workflow-decision-closure.spec.md. Traverse request/repository/confirmed-parent decision branches to resolved, explicitly excluded/deferred or dependent-blocked states; preserve autonomous fact/technical resolution, opt-in exhaustive interviewing, batch approvals and zero-question fast paths without skipping coverage. Planner maps every upstream item and all required phases, reports each Slice result and remaining gap, and confirms only a new material delta. Generalized integration-to-CLI and prototype-first-to-prototype-only counterexamples must fail the handoff completeness check; clear requests and already-confirmed decisions must not acquire extra confirmation. Update existing route/contract tests and sanitized multi-turn fixture inputs; static checks establish contract coverage, not provider obedience. No new decision engine, generic scheduler, store or mandatory interview.
